findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so its key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the amount of data protected by a single key and the impact of any key compromise, and it fails the CIS/AWS key-management guidance on rotation for customer-managed keys.

deletion_window_in_days is set to the minimum of 7 days, leaving only a short period to detect and cancel an accidental or malicious ScheduleKeyDeletion. If the key is destroyed, all data encrypted with it — including the audit/log bucket contents — becomes permanently unrecoverable.
